_comment: Which proxmox-iso builder attributes must be driven by the Ludus build-time variables rather than hard-coded. Derived from the builtin templates in ludus-server/packer/, the Bad Sector Labs source templates, and docs/docs/using-ludus/templates.md. Regenerate with `make update-reference`.

required_bindings.why: API endpoint of the Ludus Proxmox server
Build on the node Ludus is configured for
Templates must land in the SHARED pool to be usable by all users
Use the server's VM storage pool (ZFS/LVM/local differ per install)
Disk format must match what the storage pool supports
Build on the Ludus NAT bridge so the installer gets DHCP + internet
Download the installer ISO to the configured ISO storage
Extra ISOs (virtio drivers, provisioning CD) go to the same ISO storage
EFI vars disk lives with the VM disks
vTPM state disk lives with the VM disks
cloud-init drive lives with the VM disks
Must be empty at build time so the plugin uses PROXMOX_USERNAME from the environment
Must be empty at build time so the plugin uses PROXMOX_TOKEN from the environment
Never hard-code an API token in a template

forbidden_attributes.why: Ludus/Proxmox allocate the next free VMID; a fixed id collides on shared servers
Ludus needs the build to end as a Proxmox template

template_name_rules.resolved_from: vm_name in a source block (variable and local references resolved from variable defaults), falling back to variable "vm_name"
template_name_rules.template_name_attribute: must be absent or equal to vm_name: Ludus looks the built template up by vm_name

ludus_os_detection: Ludus reads the literal default of variable "os" (regex over the file) and maps win*/w2k*/wxp/wvista -> windows, l2* -> linux, anything else -> other; with no such variable it guesses from the template name
